intro: Kodobane's Head is the severed head of Barak Kodobane, a cunning Kolkar centaur chieftain. Taken as proof of his demise, it is brought to the orc warlord Regthar Deathgate to show that the centaur threat near the Forgotten Pools has been broken.

p: The Kolkar centaur of the Barrens have historically been a fractured, disorganized nuisance, yet the rise of ambitious warlords threatens to unite their marauding bands into an army. Barak Kodobane established his encampment at the lush waters of the Forgotten Pools, cutting off vital oasis resources and raiding nearby paths. Regthar Deathgate, stationed in a bunker west of the Crossroads, demands his severed head as undeniable proof that this commander can no longer rally his brutal kin against the Horde.
